snippet.title: Smith's Chronicles: Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Smith’s Chronicles is a cozy blacksmith life sim where every creation helps restore a forgotten town. Fresh out of the prestigious Westclover Academy, you receive a letter asking you to return to your hometown of Grandall, a once-thriving town that has slowly fallen into decline. As its newest blacksmith, you’ll forge a new future by rebuilding the town, welcoming fantasy townsfolk, and creating a place where everyone can finally belong.

Wishlist Smith's Chronicles on Steam: https://bit.ly/smithsonsteam
Join Arsanesia Community Server: https://discord.gg/N2vBaxHhH7
